metadata.name: phygital_spend
metadata.description: Passkey-gated SPL spending, composed with phygital-token verify_asset

instructions.name: execute_spend
docs: Spends `amount` of the delegated SPL token from the asset owner's wallet to `recipient`.
WebAuthn verification is performed via CPI to `phygital_token::verify_asset`, binding the
spend to `recipient | mint | amount` (see [`build_spend_verify_message`]). The transaction
must include a matching secp256r1 verify instruction earlier in the same transaction.
The owner must have approved this program's per-asset `spend_authority` PDA as the SPL delegate.

accounts.name: spend_authority
docs: Per-asset SPL delegate (this program's PDA) the owner approved; signs the delegated transfer.

errors.name: SpendMintMismatch
errors.msg: The token account mint does not match the spend mint

errors.name: AssetIsNotLocked
errors.msg: The asset must be locked to spend its delegated allowance

errors.name: SpendAmountZero
errors.msg: Spend amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: SpendDelegateMismatch
errors.msg: The token account's delegate is not this asset's spend authority

errors.name: InsufficientSpendAllowance
errors.msg: Spend amount exceeds the delegated allowance

errors.name: InvalidPhygitalTokenProgram
errors.msg: The phygital-token program account does not match the expected program id

errors.name: InvalidAssetAccount
errors.msg: The asset account is not a valid phygital-token asset
